 Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) Historical Data — CryptoStruct Low-Latency Trading Solutions Historical Data Historical Day Bundles Bundles Real-Time Data Real-Time Pricing Analyze Exchange Status Status Enterprise Cart Home › Options Data › ETH options (USDC linear) Deribit · option chain · ETH_USDC Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) Historical Data Every Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) contract — all strikes and expiries, calls and puts — with every trade print, every Level-2 book update and the venue's greeks/IV stream, captured co-located with nanosecond venue and receive timestamps. 453 trading days as option-chain day bundles, €1 per day, bought as a guest with instant download. Browse & buy ETH options (USDC linear) days Deribit venue data → Free sample contract → Trading days 453 Coverage August 2025 – present Archive size 727 GB Price per day €1 Activity & identifier ETH options (USDC linear) on Deribit — activity Trades and USD premium turnover summed over every contract of the option chain across 30 captured days to 2026-11-14, from the recorded tick data — the per-day averages divide by the captured days. Turnover is the option premium traded, not the notional value of the underlying. Buy share, quoted spread (in USDC, the currency the premium quotes in), best-bid/ask depth and Level-2 update counts are turnover-weighted over the same window. Avg trades / day 365 Avg turnover / day $237.7K Captured days 30 Trades (30d) 10,958 Turnover (30d) $7.1M Contracts traded / day 131 Buy share 47 % Avg spread 2.92 USDC Top-1 depth $47.3K L2 updates / day 63.2M L2 updates / trade 172888.3 30d vs prior 30d +172.8 % Since 2026-08-07 31.4K trades · $22.8M Record day $4.3M · 2026-08-07 Put/call (turnover) 1.63 Files on latest day 632 What's in a bundle One purchase, the whole option chain for a day An option-chain day bundle contains every ETH options (USDC linear) contract — all strikes and expiries, calls and puts — that was listed on Deribit on that UTC day (632 contract files on the latest covered day). Each file carries the full raw feed: every trade print, Level-2 order-book updates and the venue's mark-price stream with implied volatility and greeks, plus the index price, in the same zstd-compressed schema as our spot and perpetual data. Days above 4 GB ship as one resumable tar. Coverage runs August 2025 – present — 453 trading days, 727 GB compressed in total. A day typically holds 557 contract files (up to 768 on the busiest day, 4.16 GB). Pick individual days in the shop calendar for €1 each; delivery is an instant per-file download or one archive for the whole day. trade that day. Buy share = taker-buy side of USD turnover. Avg spread = quoted bid-ask spread of the option premium in USDC, weighted by turnover across the day’s contracts. Top-1 depth = mean of the best bid and best ask notional in USD, weighted by turnover. L2 updates = order-book level updates recorded across all contracts of the day. Days captured before the extended statistics show —. Turnover is the premium traded in USD (size × price) — not the notional value of the underlying. Days left counts whole UTC days to the expiry day. Buy share = taker-buy side of USD turnover; spread = the contract’s turnover-weighted quoted bid-ask spread in USDC; top-1 depth = mean USD value resting at the best bid and best ask; L2 updates = order-book level updates recorded for the contract that day. Replay Download Why CryptoStruct Why buy Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) data here Four things every page on this site is built on — and the reason the numbers above exist at all. We record everything The complete public feed of each venue as it was published: every Level-2 snapshot and update, every trade with its aggressor side, every quote, funding, mark-price and liquidation event — for every instrument the venue lists, every UTC day since we added the venue. Where a venue offers more than one order-book feed, we take the one with the lowest latency, at the depth that feed carries. Nothing sampled, no on-demand capture. Institutional grade Captured co-located at the venue with the exchange timestamp and our receive timestamp in integer nanoseconds, an event-id chain that makes any gap visible, and one normalized schema across 35+ venues — the same capture our own high-frequency trading engine and enterprise feeds run on. €1 per instrument-day Any instrument-day is €1, series-day bundles start at €1 — no subscription, no minimum order, no tiers to unlock. Credit packs lower the effective price and never expire, and free full-day samples from the major venues let you test first. Self-service for everyone Pick the days in the Data Shop , pay by card as a guest and download immediately — no sales call, no enterprise contract, no KYC. Coding agents buy the same files through the MCP server , and the free Agent Skill teaches them the format. Agents: /llms.txt · MCP server /mcp · every page as markdown via Accept: text/markdown FAQ Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) data — FAQ What Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) data can I download? Every call and put of the chain — all strikes and expiries — for one UTC day (632 contract files on the latest day): tick-by-tick trades, Level-2 order-book updates and the venue's mark-price stream with implied volatility and greeks (delta, gamma, vega, theta). How far back does the ETH options (USDC linear) data go? Coverage runs August 2025 – present — 453 trading days in total. How is a ETH options (USDC linear) day delivered? Per contract file, or as one archive for the day. Days above 4 GB compressed ship as a resumable tar stream instead of a ZIP. Can I get Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) data as CSV or Parquet? Yes — every free sample and every purchased tick day also exports as gzipped CSV or Parquet at no extra cost: trades in both formats, plus top-of-book (BBO) quotes as CSV. Timestamps are integer microseconds UTC and the columns load straight into pandas, polars or DuckDB — see the formats overview . How much does Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) historical data cost? €1 per option-chain day bundle — the whole chain for that day — no subscription, no minimum order; buy as a guest in the Data Shop and download immediately. Credit packs lower the effective price and never expire. Do I need an account or a sales call? No. Pick the ETH options (USDC linear) chain-days in the Data Shop , pay by card as a guest and download immediately — no subscription, no minimum order, no KYC, no enterprise contract, no sales call. Coding agents buy the same bundles through the MCP server . How is the Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) data captured? Co-located at the venue, message by message: every Level-2 update and every trade print carries the exchange timestamp and our receive timestamp in integer nanoseconds, an event-id chain makes any gap visible, and one normalized schema across 35+ venues means a parser written for Binance reads these files unchanged. It is the same capture our own high-frequency trading engine runs on — nothing sampled. How many ETH options (USDC linear) contracts trade per day on Deribit? On average 131 ETH options (USDC linear) contracts had at least one trade per UTC day over the last 30 captured days on Deribit, with about 63.2M order-book level updates recorded per day. A day bundle contains every contract file of the option chain for that day. How liquid are Deribit ETH options (USDC linear) contracts? Over the last 30 captured days, the turnover-weighted quoted bid-ask spread was 2.92 USDC (premiums on this chain quote in USDC), the mean best-bid/best-ask notional was about $47.3K per side, 47 % of USD turnover was taker-buy. These figures are computed from the recorded Level-2 order books and trade prints — the same data in the day bundles. What was the most traded ETH options (USDC linear) contract on 2026-11-14? ETH_USDC-25DEC26-1800-P (put · strike 1,800 · expiry 2026-12-25) — $54.2K USD premium turnover over 49 trades on Deribit. The 10 most traded contracts of the option chain did 151 trades and $252.7K that UTC day. Open, high, low, close and VWAP per contract are listed on this page; the tick-level data is in the day bundle. What was the busiest ETH options (USDC linear) trading day on Deribit? 2026-08-07, with $4.3M of USD premium turnover over 354 trades across every ETH options (USDC linear) contract of the day; the busiest full month was Aug 2026 at $11.6M. Since our statistics began on 2026-08-07 the option chain has recorded 31,392 trades and $22.8M over 100 captured days; the single biggest contract was ETH_USDC-25DEC26-11000-P on 2026-08-07 with $4.1M. Any of these days is a downloadable bundle. What is the put/call ratio on ETH options (USDC linear)? 1.63 by USD turnover over the 30 captured days of the window on Deribit — $4.4M in puts against $2.7M in calls, with 1,946 put and 1,969 call contracts traded. Computed from every trade print of every strike and expiry in the chain; the per-day split is in the daily table above.
